description: This file defines the SavedNewsScreen widget for a Flutter application, displaying a list of saved news articles and allowing deletion and navigation to detailed view.

classes.name: SavedNewsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a list of saved news articles, with options to open or delete each item.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI for the saved news screen, showing either a message for no saved news or a list of saved articles.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed view of the specified news article.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Asks user confirmation to delete a news article and performs deletion if confirmed.
